evidence_spans: The Democratic Party is a liberal political party in the United States, sitting on the center to center-left of the political spectrum.
Founded in 1828, it is the world's oldest active political party.
On economic issues, the party favors healthcare reform, paid sick leave, paid family leave and supporting unions.
Democrats have been more liberal on civil rights since 1948, although conservative factions within the Democratic Party that opposed them persisted in the South until the 1960s.
